landing.hero.title: Live zmanim boards your congregation can trust
landing.hero.body: Design wall displays, schedule minyanim, and push announcements — then open a full-screen board on any TV.

landing.feature.tenant.body: Each shul owns schedules, memorials, sponsors, and screens.
